assertions.claim: Elders' benefits (peace of mind, face, nagging stops) are real but do not automatically become your health benefit or relationship quality
assertions.cn_span: 长辈那份收益（安心、面子、不再催）是真的，但它不会自动变成你的健康收益或关系质量

assertions.claim: The time account, money account and exit cost are all borne by you yourself
assertions.cn_span: 而时间账、钱账和退出成本这三笔全部由你自己承担

assertions.claim: Split the page into two columns — which benefits are yours, which are the elders' — and whether the deal is worth it is visible at a glance
assertions.cn_span: 在纸上分两栏，把哪些收益归自己、哪些归长辈写开，这笔账划不划算自己一眼就能看出来

assertions.claim: This item does not conclude for the reader; the elders' account can also be counted as a heavy one
assertions.cn_span: 这一条不替读者下结论，长辈的账也可以算成很重的一笔

assertions.claim: Cross-references: time account (item 9), money account (items 10-12), exit cost (item 16) all borne by the person marrying
assertions.cn_span: 时间账（第 9 条）、钱账（第 10 到 12 条）和退出成本（第 16 条）全部由当事人承担
